scoring: Equal-cell mean dB ratio-of-sums NMSE. Groups average metrics across fits, never channel estimates. Pooled linear NMSE averages fit-specific error/energy ratios arithmetically; pooled dB is its10log10. Pooled and case-tail metrics are diagnostic.
primary: None: raw starts are descriptive diagnostics.

bootstrap.unit: Whole-channel multinomial local index shared across SNR/reference/method/fit within each regime
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on frozen trained weights, calibrated controls and grid; excludes training-population and selection uncertainty.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Bonferroni4 only for the two hybrid primary contrasts in all153, with their two BER outcomes. All other intervals descriptive pointwise95.
